{{Top|leg}}
A '''mechgill''' resembled a [[Rebreather/Legends|rebreather]] unit, but functioned by extracting [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] from most liquid sources. It could operate at a depth up to 10,000 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] for around six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].
